title: Derivative and pivotal indicator
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the sign cube $\\{−1,1\\}^n$, let $i$ be a coordinate, and let $x$ be a point of the cube. The absolute value of the discrete derivative of the real-valued version of $f$ at $x$ in coordinate $i$ equals the indicator that flipping coordinate $i$ changes $f(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$x$ is a point of the sign cube
